title: Ioas: which version is easiest to follow?
intro: Leroy Ioas, Our Responsibilities: 40 seconds, muffled (about 3 kHz) with tape hiss. Five versions in random order: the original, one classic broadcast chain, and three GPU restorations that passed the automatic word-loss check. All are matched to the same loudness. Listen for whether every word and word-ending comes through and how tiring it would be over an hour. Pick the one you would rather listen to for a whole talk; the original is a fine answer.
